adj.description: Adjacency matrix: $1$ if $a$ is adjacent to $a'$, $0$ otherwise

r.description: Reward for a class $k$ flight being at location $a$ at time $t$

assumptions.description: Every location is adjacent to itself.

code.python: assert all(adj[a][a] == 1 for a in range(nA))
assert all(cap[a][t] >= 0 for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT))
assert all(nP[k] >= 0 for k in range(nK))

n.description: Number of class $k$ flights at location $a$ at time $t$

f.description: Number of class $k$ flights moving from $a$ at time $t$ to $a'$ at time $t+1$

constraints.description: All flights of every class are accounted for at every time period.
constraints.formulation: \sum_{a \in A} n_{k,a,t} = nP_k \quad \forall k \in K, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(n[k, a, t] for a in range(nA)) == nP[k] for k in range(nK) for t in range(nT))

constraints.description: The flights of all classes at a location do not exceed the location capacity.
constraints.formulation: \sum_{k \in K} n_{k,a,t} \leq \text{cap}_{a,t} \quad \forall a \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(n[k, a, t] for k in range(nK)) <= cap[a][t] for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

constraints.description: Flow conservation: class $k$ flights at location $a$ at time $t$ equal those at $t-1$ plus arrivals minus departures (one-step transitions).
constraints.formulation: n_{k,a,t} = n_{k,a,t-1} + \sum_{a' \in A} f_{k,a',a,t-1} - \sum_{a' \in A} f_{k,a,a',t-1} \quad \forall k \in K, a \in A, t \in T, t > 0

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(n[k, a, t] == n[k, a, t-1] + gp.quicksum(f[k, a2, a, t-1] for a2 in range(nA)) - gp.quicksum(f[k, a, a2, t-1] for a2 in range(nA)) for k in range(nK) for a in range(nA) for t in range(1, nT))

constraints.description: Movements are only allowed between adjacent locations.
constraints.formulation: f_{k,a,a',t} \leq nP_k \times \text{adj}_{a,a'} \quad \forall k \in K, a, a' \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(f[k, a, a2, t] <= nP[k] * adj[a][a2] for k in range(nK) for a in range(nA) for a2 in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

constraints.description: No movements out of the final time period (would arrive outside the horizon).
constraints.formulation: f_{k,a,a',nT-1} = 0 \quad \forall k \in K, a, a' \in A

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(f[k, a, a2, nT-1] == 0 for k in range(nK) for a in range(nA) for a2 in range(nA))

constraints.description: Aggregate departures at time $t$ do not exceed presence at time $t$ (stay-flow non-negativity).
constraints.formulation: \sum_{a' \in A} f_{k,a,a',t} \leq n_{k,a,t} \quad \forall k \in K, a \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(f[k, a, a2, t] for a2 in range(nA)) <= n[k, a, t] for k in range(nK) for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

constraints.formulation: n_{k,a,t} \geq 0 \quad \forall k \in K, a \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(n[k, a, t] >= 0 for k in range(nK) for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

constraints.formulation: f_{k,a,a',t} \geq 0 \quad \forall k \in K, a, a' \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(f[k, a, a2, t] >= 0 for k in range(nK) for a in range(nA) for a2 in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

objective.description: Maximize total reward for all flights across all classes, locations, and time periods.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(r[k][a][t] * n[k, a, t] for k in range(nK) for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

notes: This is the aggregate (efficient) formulation: one flow network per plane class, coupled only through the location capacities.
